name: 海洋（基础版）
group_note: 海洋 (haiyang) themed, distinct codebase from hy2000 (079)/hy2002 (080)/hy5 -- master hash doesn't match any existing lib, no confirmed lineage; finished an interrupted conversion (leftover static keyword, uppercase .C files), removed a duplicate-create() textual ftpd.lpc include (§7.40), and guarded master.lpc's creator_file/domain_file/author_file() against a load-during-compile recursion (find_object(SIMUL_EFUN_OB) check) that otherwise crashed boot entirely. Full WASM pass: fixed is_chinese() codepoint bug, check_legal_name() length bounds, added loopback-allow to band.lpc, fixed a genuine typo in adm/daemons/securityd.lpc (unrelated dead-code duplicate of the real security daemon adm/daemons/securd.lpc -- SECURITY_D macro actually points at securd.lpc). Two deeper bugs found and fixed in adm/daemons/logind.lpc: (1) create() left the daemon's euid unset, and a later seteuid(getuid()) call in howmany_user()/make_body() reset it back to empty mid-registration since the daemon's real uid never resolves either -- fixed all three call sites to seteuid(ROOT_UID) explicitly; (2) howmany_visitor()/howmany_card() crashed via sscanf(0,...) whenever their counter files (/log/mud/MUDVISITOR, GIFTCARD) don't exist yet -- a real first-boot bug since libs/*/work/**/log is gitignored, not just a WASM-sandbox artifact -- fixed by returning 0 when read_file() returns falsy. Also fixed a reentrant-compile crash in adm/daemons/securd.lpc's get_status(): member_array(euid, wiz_levels) crashes when called on the object before its own variable initializers finish (wiz_levels declared after wiz_status, so a reentrant call during create()'s restore()->valid_read() chain sees it still unset) -- guarded with arrayp(wiz_levels). Admin seeded directly in adm/daemons/securd.o's saved wiz_status mapping (NOT /adm/etc/wizlist, which this lineage's real security daemon never reads) -- edited with binary-mode file I/O since this lineage encodes '/' as a literal CR (0x0D) byte in mapping keys, which Python's default text-mode newline translation would silently mangle into LF. Registration through world-entry fully verified for both a plain player and the fluffos/admin account (admin-only entry notices confirmed firing); post-login look/score/quit echo occasionally raced against async entry-banner call_outs in scripted WASM tests (same class of harmless test-harness timing artifact as nt6/nt6nitan6win), not a mudlib bug.
